description: This file defines template classes for plugin monitoring and interface management within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It includes classes for monitoring plugin activation/deactivation, managing interface acquisition, and handling communication channels for plugins and controllers, with specializations for in-process and out-of-process plugins.

classes.name: PluginMonitorType
classes.description: Template class for monitoring plugin activation and deactivation, managing interface pointers, and notifying handlers.

classes.name: SmartInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing interfaces exposed by plugins, handling activation/deactivation, and communication channels.

classes.name: PluginSmartInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for plugin-side interface management, handling plugin activation/deactivation, and interface access.

classes.name: SmartControllerInterfaceType
classes.description: Template class for managing controller interfaces, establishing communication channels, and handling connection lifecycle.

methods.name: IsOperational
methods.description: Checks if the plugin or interface is operational.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Sets the callsign for plugin monitoring.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin or interface with the monitoring system.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin or interface from the monitoring system.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a plugin or controller.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the connection to a plugin or controller.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a specific interface from the plugin or controller.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Callback for derived classes to handle operational state changes.

methods.name: Activated
methods.description: Internal callback invoked when a plugin/interface is activated.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Internal callback invoked when a plugin/interface is deactivated.

methods.name: RegisterJob
methods.description: Job class for deferred registration of plugin interfaces.
